experiments.name: checkout_button_copy
experiments.description: Copy test on the pay button.
experiments.hypothesis: Saying 'Pay now' instead of 'Continue' makes the last step clearer and lifts checkout conversion by 2%.

experiments.name: delivery_eta_display
experiments.description: Show a live ETA range instead of a single time.
experiments.hypothesis: A range instead of a single time sets honest expectations, so delivery ratings go up and support tickets go down.

experiments.name: survey_incentive_test
experiments.description: Discount offered in the exit survey.

experiments.name: homepage_hero_test
experiments.hypothesis: A seasonal hero image makes the home page feel current and lifts add-to-cart from the home page by 3%.

experiments.name: free_delivery_threshold
experiments.hypothesis: A lower free delivery threshold raises order frequency more than it lowers basket value.

experiments.name: recipe_recommendations
experiments.description: Recipe suggestions based on the basket.
experiments.hypothesis: Recipes that use what is already in the basket lead to more recipe saves and a larger basket.

experiments.name: cart_reminder_timing
experiments.description: When to send the abandoned cart reminder.
experiments.hypothesis: A reminder two hours after a cart is abandoned recovers more orders than one sent the next morning.

holdouts.description: Two percent of users held back from Q4 launches.
